experience.title: Along temporary experience
experience.description: A local test profile, not an online account. No email, password or code is needed. Try local photos, trips and 3D keepsakes on this device.
experience.entered: Local experience started; no email or online sign-in was used.
experience.memory: Experience started for this session only. Local storage is unavailable, so it may not resume after reopening.
experience.exited: Local experience ended. Your photos and keepsakes were not deleted.
experience.unavailable: This build does not allow local experience, or you need to sign out of the online account first.
experience.online.blocked: This is a local experience account. Community publishing, cloud AI, uploads and production inquiries require a configured server and real sign-in. No request was sent.
online.auth.unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable or email delivery is not configured. Please try again later.
online.auth.local: Local development account: {email}. No email was sent.
online.auth.devcode: Local development only — this code was not emailed: {code}. Production never shows codes here.
map.title: Baidu map and navigation
map.privacy: Loading the map connects to Baidu. Location is requested only when you choose Use my location. Route searches are sent to the map provider.
map.start: Choose a place or load the map. You can also open Baidu web navigation below.
map.placeholder: The map has not been loaded. Your location has not been requested.
map.navigation.hint: Turn-by-turn navigation is provided by Baidu. If the app does not open, use web navigation or copy the destination.
map.name.resolved: Place resolved by Baidu. Check the marker before navigating; legacy coordinate systems were not assumed.
map.search.failed: No usable place was returned. Try a more specific address or another city.
map.ready: Choose your start and destination to plan a route.
map.unconfigured: Baidu map credentials are not configured. In-app maps are unavailable; the Baidu web navigation link remains available for a chosen destination.
map.failed: The map could not be loaded. Check the connection, key permissions or browser support.
map.locating: Requesting your location and converting it to Baidu coordinates…
map.location.failed: Location or coordinate conversion failed. Check permission and map configuration, or search for a starting point manually.
map.route.failed: No route was returned. Check the two places and travel mode, or use Baidu web navigation.
map.app.hint: If Baidu Maps did not open, use the web navigation button.
map.copy.failed: Could not copy. Select the displayed destination name instead.
